item.title: 8 attempted suicides by sailors in USS Lincoln strike group during deployment, navy letter says
item.description: According to a letter from the acting Navy secretary, there were eight attempted suicides by sailors in the USS Lincoln strike group during the vessel's 10-month deployment. Charlie D'Agata has more.

item.title: Trump rolls out the red carpet for Xi despite U.S.-China tensions
item.description: It's not clear what specific goals President Trump wants to accomplish in his meeting with the Chinese leader.

item.title: Chinese and Iranian presidents both visit U.S.
item.description: Chinese President Xi Jinping and Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian are both in the U.S., fulfilling diplomatic engagements as tensions remain high with both countries. Margaret Brennan has more.

item.title: Hurricane Polo is a powerful Category 4 storm off Mexico. See its path.
item.description: Hurricane Polo intensified rapidly in the Pacific off the southwestern Mexican coast, growing into a Category 5 storm before weakening slightly to a Category 4. Here's the latest on its path.

item.title: Trump welcomes Chinese President Xi Jinping for state visit as tensions build over AI, Iran
item.description: President Trump welcomed Chinese President Xi Jinping on Wednesday for a state visit that is expected to include talk of artificial intelligence, Iran and more. Nancy Cordes reports.

item.title: East Coast faces threat of powerful winds, flooding as Nor'easter builds
item.description: Both coasts are bracing for the possibility of extreme weather as a Nor'easter builds in the East and California is threatened by Hurricane Polo. Rob Marciano breaks it down and shares the forecast.

item.title: Tropical Storm Nolo forms in Pacific, Hawaii under hurricane watch
item.description: Nolo is expected to become a hurricane sometime Thursday, and could become a major hurricane by the weekend as it approaches Hawaii's Big Island.

item.title: Republican candidates in tight races distance themselves from Trump, Iran war ahead of midterms
item.description: Some Republican candidates in competitive midterm contests are pushing for the Trump administration to wind down the war with Iran and focus more on Americans struggling with affordability. CBS News political reporter Zak Hudak joins to discuss.

item.title: Trump-Xi summit not expected to result in binding, comprehensive AI agreement, analysts say
item.description: President Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping met in Washington, D.C., amid tensions over Iran, the global energy supply, trade, Taiwan and artificial intelligence. CBS News correspondent Natalie Brand reports.

item.title: Judge dismisses Trump's 2024 lawsuit against Iowa newspaper over poll results
item.description: An Iowa judge sided with pollster J. Ann Selzer and The Des Moines Register, saying that allowing the lawsuit and its "faulty" claims to proceed could "discourage others from reporting on and debating public affairs."

item.title: U.S., Iran hold first talks since June as Trump threatens annihilation
item.description: U.S. and Iranian delegations met on the sidelines of the U.N. General Assembly, rekindling diplomacy amid Trump's threat to "annihilate" the regime.

item.title: Lawsuits allege Six Flags' X2 roller coaster left riders with brain injuries
item.description: Six Flags is facing three new lawsuits alleging a roller coaster at its Magic Mountain amusement park in Southern California left more than 100 riders with brain injuries. CBS News national correspondent Carter Evans has the latest.

item.title: Storm system over East Coast to strengthen into nor'easter, National Weather Service warns
item.description: The National Weather Service is officially warning of a nor'easter storm this weekend, from a system that already hit parts of the mid-Atlantic on Wednesday. CBS New York chief weathercaster Lonnie Quinn has the latest forecast.

item.title: Dunwoody students rebuild car for Navy veteran in Minneapolis
item.description: Automotive collision and refinishing students at Dunwoody College in Minneapolis rebuilt a Hyundai Elantra and gave it to Robert Hanson, a U.S. Navy veteran, through the National Auto Body Council's Recycled Rides program.

item.title: A new book ranks the greatest American presidents in history. Here's who made the cut.
item.description: American historian and political analyst Allan Lichtman is well known for accurately predicting the winners in nine out of the last 11 elections since 1984. Now, he's ranking the nation's top leaders with his new book, "Great American Presidents." Lichtman joins "The Takeout" to discuss who stood out to him and why.

item.title: Dolly Parton's estate granted restraining order against her nephew over threats
item.description: A Tennessee judge granted Dolly Parton's estate a temporary restraining order Wednesday against the late singer's nephew Bryan Seaver and his private security company.

item.title: New polls show Democrats with edge in Senate, governor's races in Texas
item.description: A new Marist poll shows Texas Republican Attorney General Ken Paxton running six points behind James Talarico, his Democratic opponent in the state's Senate race. Political strategists Adam Piper and Hannah Muldavin join with analysis.

item.title: Harvey Weinstein sentenced to 15 years in New York sexual assault case
item.description: Harvey Weinstein, the disgraced movie mogul, was sentenced to 15 years in prison Wednesday morning for sexually assaulting Miriam Haley at his Manhattan apartment in 2006.

item.title: Rep. John Moolenaar says U.S. has "responsibility to help Taiwan defend itself" before Xi visit
item.description: According to a Reuters exclusive, Chinese President Xi Jinping plans to urge President Trump to halt all arms sales to Taiwan, which Beijing views as its own territory. Republican Rep. John Moolenaar of Michigan, chairman of the House Select Committee on China, joins with his response.

item.title: Republicans outspend Democrats on ads in key Senate races
item.description: Even though most polls show Democrats gaining momentum ahead of Election Day, Republicans are heavily outspending them on advertising in key Senate races. Politico senior data reporter Jessica Piper joins "The Takeout" to discuss.

item.title: What to know about Iranian president's U.N. speech
item.description: Speeches and diplomacy continued at the U.N. General Assembly on Wednesday. CBS News Middle East contributor Courtney Kealy has more.

item.title: Fat Bear Week 2026 is here, and voting already "broke the internet"
item.description: Sixteen bears are vying for votes in Fat Bear Week​ 2026, the highly anticipated contest among the chunkiest bears at the Katmai National Park and Preserve in Alaska.

item.title: Tech leaders call for international cooperation to ensure safe AI development at U.N. meeting
item.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei are among the artificial intelligence executives briefing the U.N. Security Council amid warnings about AI's possible threat to humanity. Fortune magazine reporter Eva Roytburg joins CBS News to discuss.

item.title: Trump to greet Xi at Joint Base Andrews, a presidential move not seen since 1962
item.description: In a rare move, President Trump departed for Joint Base Andrews on Wednesday afternoon to welcome Chinese President Xi Jinping upon his landing. CBS News chief White House correspondent Nancy Cordes reports. Then, Hoover Institute fellow Lanhee Chen joins with analysis.

item.title: Co-worker: Gilgo murders suspect unnerved her by tracking her down on a cruise
item.description: Exclusive details about the NYC architect accused of being the Long Island serial killer, his life and how he may have been hiding in plain sight for more than a decade.

item.title: More Republican candidates break with Trump as midterms approach
item.description: More Republicans in competitive races are calling on President Trump to end the war in Iran, hoping to create distance from the president's record-low poll numbers and his inflation-fueling war. CBS News chief Washington correspondent Major Garrett has more.

item.title: Could Boise's "Unknown Wanderer" be linked to Chicago Tylenol murders?
item.description: Boise police have identified a man known as the "Unknown Wanderer" who was found dead in a church in 1982, and revealed a possible link to the Chicago Tylenol murders.

item.title: 9/23: The Takeout with Major Garrett
item.description: President Trump to hold arrival ceremony for Chinese President Xi Jinping; judge yet to rule on Mr. Trump's ban on news outlets from White House.

item.title: Judge skeptical of Trump's White House ban on CNN, MS NOW and Politico
item.description: A federal judge signaled he is skeptical of President Trump's ban on CNN, MS NOW and Politico from White House grounds.

item.title: Social Security tax hike "financially impossible" for many, expert says
item.description: Raising payroll taxes enough to stabilize Social Security could add thousands of dollars in annual costs, according to one analysis.
